dataset.note: Flutter parity = its effective `readings` digest equals `dataset.digest` (collectionDigest over documentHash, scripts/content/lib/app-content.mjs). Per-document `hash` lets a client list exactly which documents differ.

schemas.unknownSectionFields: preserve and ignore: year, form, altChorusRef, rubrics, conclusion, alternatives[].form

idRules.documentId: `readings/<id>`: stable string, never reused; legacy projections are `<canonical>--<variant|cycle>`
idRules.selector: date:DD.MM | feast:<code without feast-> | period:<type>:w<week>:d<dow> (lookups of the Ordo engine, src/utils/ordo/readings.js)
idRules.cycleRule: Sunday cycle A when (liturgical-year start year mod 3) = 0, B = 1, C = 2 (Advent 2025 starts A); weekday year 1 for odd, 2 for even calendar years

defaults.rule: explicit set.default → evening/vigil set when a daytime set also exists → first set (src/utils/massReadingSets.js defaultSetId)
defaults.resolution: route ?option=<optionId>&set=<setId>&year=<A|B|C|1|2>; the set choice is independent of the Office option choice

ordering: sections keep the source order (set.sections); psalm refrain slots: chorus, altChorus (+ altChorusRef); long/short readings: alternatives[] with form

edgeCases.description: Canonical documents carry only massReadings.sets; released apps skip them (hasReadingDocumentContent = false). The new client must read the sets.
Legacy documents that are projections of a canonical set carry `_massReadingsRef`; hide them when the canonical document is also loaded (collapseCoveredDocuments).
Sets with referenceOnly=true carry citations only; render citations and the notice, never invent text.
Documents with several sets: choose the default set by rule/policy; persist the user choice in the route (?set=).
Ordinary-time weekdays are stored as <base>--1 / <base>--2 (weekday year I / II); both are read from one source page (408 documents).
On a Sunday 24.12 the engine offers the Sunday of Advent AND the Christmas Vigil Mass (lookup {_date:24.12,_variant:christmas-vigil}); the vigil group is the default (evening).
Sundays of Advent 17–24.12 and II Sunday after Christmas use the period documents (advent-w4-d1--A/B/C, christmas-w2-d1), not the date documents of that day (engine change of this audit).
When 02.11 is a Sunday (2025, 2031) Hours = Sunday, Mass = All Souls with three sets; default first.
Pentecost Saturday that coincides with a feast (31.05.2031 Visitation) offers no Pentecost Vigil Mass option (open decision).
The readings document 02-07-our-lady-budslav-minsk is restricted to minsk-mohilev; Vitebsk/Pinsk/Grodno show the celebration without readings (open decision).
Until the resync migration is applied, many legacy psalms store the LAST strophe in altChorus and truncate the strophes; compare per-section hashes with the contract, not slots.
